beforeRecord.lead: Distinguish an identified feed order from a request for a supplementation discussion.
beforeRecord.decisionTitle: Distinguish an identified feed order from a request for a supplementation discussion.
beforeRecord.decision:
Farmers Grain Company lists bulk feed delivery and bag mineral alongside feed and supplement lines. Its feed page also describes on-farm consultation and hay sampling with a feed specialist. The company gives its contact address in Pond Creek.

A feed-business website can let a producer explain whether they already know the product needed or want a specialist discussion first. The consultation route should preserve the purpose of the inquiry, while a product request should carry the product and delivery question. The business confirms what its locations can supply and what a consultation involves.

scopes.title: Distinguish an identified feed order from a request for a supplementation discussion
pages: Provide a direct route for a named product and delivery inquiry.
Explain the specialist conversation and hay-sampling service without prescribing a program.
Carry the relevant location and broad delivery area into follow-up.
scopes.request: Identify a known feed product or ask for a specialist discussion, then give the relevant location and delivery question for the company to review.
scopes.supplies: Current product names, order contact and location-specific fulfillment information. Approved service descriptions and the questions the specialist needs first. Actual delivery coverage and staff who confirm arrangements.
scopes.check: A product listing does not imply stock at every branch. An unsure producer can ask for a discussion without inventing a product selection. The Pond Creek contact address does not become a promise that every listed mill is in Grant County.

beforeRecord.scopeTrigger: A focused edit can clarify known product on the existing page. A fuller project can connect known product, advice request, location and delivery across the introduction and staff handoff. Agree the actual pages, approved information and update owner before selecting forms or connections.
quoteQuestions: How do you distinguish an order inquiry from a specialist consultation?
Which locations actually fulfill the products you list?
What location detail is needed before discussing bulk delivery?
